subject: Recap: Discovery — data handling, logging & model-tuning restrictions
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@clearbridgehealth.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Discovery — data handling, logging & model-tuning restrictions

Hi Emma / Marco,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate the clear framing on risk posture. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary from our call
- ClearBridge wants to ensure no customer data is used to tune or improve models at any time.
- Primary concerns: PII exposure in outputs, auditability of request logs, and retention period for logs.
- Preferred deployment: private VPC (for data isolation) with customer-managed KMS.

Redwood commitments (what we can do today)
- Option A: Disable model-training ingestion for your org so none of your data flows into our model improvement pipelines.
- Option B: If you still want hosted inference, we can enable a strict "no-tuning" flag at the tenant level and enforce via routing + read-only telemetry.
- Logging: configurable retention window; default is 90 days for request/response logs, but we can set it to 30/60/90, and provide an export before deletion.
- PII controls: we offer configurable pre-ingest scrubbing and can work with your team to define regex/lexicon rules.

Action items / proposed next steps
1) Emma/Marco: confirm you want the model-tuning block at tenant level (yes/no) and preferred log retention window.
2) If yes to block, we’ll produce a short DPA addendum reflecting that restriction and a sequence for implementation.
3) Aditya / Redwood Legal (cc’d) will share SOC2 summary and a proposed DPA snippet.
4) Schedule 30-min procurement run-through once the DPA draft is ready.

Attachments: I’m attaching a short PSA on our data handling options (redwood-data-psa.pdf).

If that looks right I’ll start the DPA draft and loop in monica for legal review.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Emma Stone <emma.stone@clearbridgehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 17:46:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery — data handling, logging & model-tuning restrictions

Neha — thanks for the clear write-up. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Model tuning: we want an explicit tenant-level block so our data cannot be used for any model improvement. This must be auditable and reversible only with our explicit signed approval.
2) Log retention: 90 days is acceptable, provided we get an automated export in case of audit (S3 or secure transfer).
3) PII controls: we will provide a 1-page sample of the types of fields we consider sensitive — attached as CBH-pii-sample.csv (sample). We’d like to ensure Redwood can run pre-ingest redaction based on those rules.
4) KMS: customer-managed KMS is a requirement for production.
5) SOC2: please provide your latest SOC2 report summary and any attestations around data segregation.

One operational ask: when you prepare the DPA addendum, can you include language that explicitly states "no customer data may be used to train or improve models" and a description of the mechanism (tenant flag + routing fallback)? We’ll review with procurement and legal.

If you can send a draft DPA snippet by end of day Monday PST, we’ll prioritize review.

Thanks,
Emma Stone
VP, IT & Security
ClearBridge Health
emma.stone@clearbridgehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0224

Attachment: CBH-pii-sample.csv (3 rows, headers only)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@clearbridgehealth.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery — data handling, logging & model-tuning restrictions

Emma — really helpful, thanks. Confirming Redwood position and next steps below (looping in Monica for legal phrasing and Aditya for SLA/ops).

What we can commit to immediately
- Tenant-level model-tuning block: we will implement a hard tenant flag that prevents any request data from being routed into training queues. That flag is reversible only via an authenticated, signed request from an approved ClearBridge contact. We will log flag-change events and provide an audit trail.
- Logging/exports: we can set retention to 90 days and provide an automated nightly export to an S3 bucket (pre-negotiated). We will also provide a one-time export on contract termination.
- PII pre-ingest scrubbing: Redwood will run configurable redaction before storage. We’ll start with the CBH-pii-sample.csv you sent and iterate.
- KMS: customer-managed KMS supported for keys at rest in private deployment.
- SOC2: attaching a SOC2 summary (SOC2-redwood-summary.pdf) and a short PSA on our controls (redwood-data-psa.pdf).

Draft DPA language
- Monica will add a short addendum clause: "Customer Data Exclusion from Model Training: Customer Data will not be used for model training, model improvement, or research without Customer's explicit written consent. Redwood shall maintain technical controls to enforce this exclusion and produce logs of enforcement actions on request."

Next steps
1) Monica to circulate the DPA addendum snippet by EOD Friday PST.
2) Neha to confirm implementation timeline for tenant-flag (~3 business days once DPA signed) and S3 export schedule.
3) Emma/Marco to share any additional PII patterns and confirm S3 destination details.

I’ll start the internal JIRA for the tenant-flag work and assign Aditya for rollout.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-redwood-summary.pdf (summary), redwood-data-psa.pdf
From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@clearbridgehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Emma Stone <emma.stone@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@clearbridgehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:24:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery — data handling, logging & model-tuning restrictions

All — sounds good. Quick confirmation from procurement side: we accept 90-day retention with nightly S3 export (put to our secure bucket), tenant-level block required. Please include private VPC deployment and customer-managed KMS in the commercial draft.

Let’s schedule the procurement call next Wednesday at 10am ET. Emma will send a calendar invite once DPA snippet arrives.

Thanks,
Marco Ruiz
Director, Procurement
ClearBridge Health
